English.Char_Desc_80: Squares up, crops and whitens photos of pages, saving clean copies.
English.Char_Desc_250: Pick a folder of scanned or photographed pages. Each gets a cleaned copy: squared up, cropped to the page, crooked text leveled and a clean white background, resized to the frame you choose. The originals are never changed.
English.Char_Desc_450: Pick a folder of scanned or photographed pages. Each gets a cleaned copy: squared up, cropped to the page, crooked text leveled and a clean white background, resized to the frame you choose. The originals are never changed. Free. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; nothing else to install.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Clean Up Scans makes cleaned copies of scanned or photographed pages in a new "cleaned" folder. A page photographed at an angle is found, its perspective corrected and cropped to the page; crooked lines of text are turned level; documents get a pure white background with shadows evened out (this can be turned off), while ordinary photos are left as they are. Screenshots are left square. Each copy is resized to fit the frame (1200 x 900 unless you change it) and marked 600 DPI, and a full-size copy can be kept too. "what was done.txt" lists what happened to each picture. Works with JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, GIF and WebP. The originals are never changed.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Clean Up Scans is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Clean Up Scans is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
